package.name: mini_ranka_bridge
package.description:
Host side of the Mini_Ranka 3-DoF BLDC arm.
telemetry_bridge republishes each firmware telemetry signal as a std_msgs/Float64 topic for PlotJuggler, decoupled from the firmware by a plain JSON-over-serial contract. joint_state_bridge adapts those signals into sensor_msgs/JointState so the mini_ranka_description model tracks the real arm, and mock_arm supplies the same joint states from a host-side replay of the firmware trajectory when no hardware is connected.
tune, feedback and flow are the operator consoles: commands out, replies in, and a live diagram of which part of that path is actually carrying data.
